items.title: NETA 65 Fall Assembly 2027
items.summary: Area 65 assembly (Panel 77) at the DoubleTree by Hilton Fort Worth South. The assembly is all day Saturday and Sunday morning (8 AM to 12 PM). There is no activity at the hotel on Friday night, though the host districts may hold something at a nearby group (to be confirmed). District 64 has confirmed as co-host; District 62 has put off its discussion until its November district meeting.

extra.location: DoubleTree by Hilton Fort Worth South Hotel & Conference Center, 100 Altamesa Blvd East, Fort Worth, TX 76134

summary.es: Asamblea del Área 65 (Panel 77), en el DoubleTree by Hilton Fort Worth South. Será todo el sábado y la mañana del domingo (de 8 a. m. a 12 p. m.). El viernes por la noche no habrá actividad en el hotel; los distritos anfitriones podrían organizar algo en un grupo cercano. El Distrito 64 confirmó que será coanfitrión; el Distrito 62 aplazó el tema hasta su reunión distrital de noviembre.
